integrity: The critical polynomial generator certificate and canonical reductions were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. The closest full same-object source was inspected through its system definition, threshold analysis, Hopf analysis, conclusion, and references; noncoverage statements are limited to material actually read.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not classify unbounded trajectories.
The height-excursion conclusion is one-sided: it forces visits above the nonzero-equilibrium height but does not force visits below it.
The theorem does not prove existence of nontrivial compact recurrence for every positive parameter choice.
The original 2004 article was not inspected in full text, and the 2008 Hopf article was inspected at abstract/bibliographic level.
Targeted searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older stationary identities.
title: Conditional stationary laws and a sharp equilibrium-height excursion in the Liu chaotic system
